name: Cliveden Green Walking Trail
summary: National Trust's circular trail, about 3.7 km, from Woodland car park, Cliveden.
notes: Route line from OpenStreetMap, built on the date shown. Nobody from Driftway has walked it, so surfaces and barriers are as mapped, not as found.

The trail is National Trust's. Check their page on the day for opening times, parking, livestock and conditions: https://www.nationaltrust.org.uk/visit/oxfordshire-buckinghamshire-berkshire/cliveden/cliveden-green-walking-trail

sources.label: OpenStreetMap route relation 10361193
sources.limitation: The trail as mapped by volunteers. The trail itself belongs to its operator; check their page on the day.
